reader.requirement: At 1985 the JUSTIFIED clause is accepted only on an elementary data description entry (any section, any level 01-49 or 77, under OCCURS or not) and on an elementary report group entry (§1985:XIII.3.9.4 GR2 makes the Report Writer clause the Nucleus one); a JUSTIFIED written on any group entry (01 or subordinate, with OCCURS or REDEFINES, in WORKING-STORAGE, LINKAGE, FILE, COMMUNICATION or REPORT SECTION) is refused. The witnesses cover the elementary working-storage case and the report-section group and element; the other sections and group shapes are not exercised.
reader.edition-search: grep for Year, DialectLevel, CobolVersion, EditionContext in CheckPictureRequiredPass.cs, DataBinder.ClausePlacement.cs (the ClausePlacementRules table) and ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportEntryFormats' group-entry JUSTIFIED arm: none switches the rule (binder.Edition.Error is the diagnostic sink only); the nearby Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 test in ReportSectionBinder belongs to the SUM-clause rule, not this one.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: elementary JUSTIFIED in WORKING-STORAGE and the report-section group/element; group entries in WORKING-STORAGE, LINKAGE, FILE and COMMUNICATION SECTIONs, a group under OCCURS or REDEFINES, and the 77 level are not exercised

reader.notes: One table row (ClausePlacementRules, ElementaryOnly: JUSTIFIED | BLANK WHEN ZERO) drives CheckElementaryOnlyClauses over every written data entry, and ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportEntryFormats refuses a report group entry below 01 that writes JUSTIFIED (level 01 is refused by the format-1 screen). Every section and group shape probed is refused and every elementary form accepted at --std 85. Diagnostics cite §2023:13.16.3 SR11 for the data-entry case (wording only).

refuter.evidence: r5-elem88.cob at --std 85 (EXIT 0): JUSTIFIED on elementary items that carry level-88 entries (01 E1 JUST with 88, 05 E2 JUSTIFIED with 88 and a 66 RENAMES of it, 77 E4 PIC A(4) JUST RIGHT with 88) and on an elementary 01 record of a FILE SECTION FD printed '[   ABC][    XY][  AB][    QQ]' and 'COND-OK'. An 88 subordinate does not make an entry a group, and the right-justification and condition values agree. r5-grp88.cob (01 G JUSTIFIED RIGHT with an 88 and a 05) is refused with COBOL2403 ('this entry has 1 subordinate entry'): the 88 is not counted and the 05 is. cite.py: 'OK §1985:VI.5.6.3 SR1 the text is in SR1' ('The JUSTIFIED clause can be specified only at the elementary item level').
